name: How are walls prepared to support heavy-duty grab bars and shower seats?

mainEntity.name: How are walls prepared to support heavy-duty grab bars and shower seats?

acceptedAnswer.text: Grab bars must be anchored directly into solid wood wall blocking rather than just drywall anchors to support weight safely. During an accessible remodel, the drywall is opened so horizontal 2x6 or 2x8 wood blocking can be framed between wall studs where bars, fold-down shower seats, or handheld shower wands will mount. After secure framing, HH Remodeling patches the drywall, applies moisture-resistant backing, and installs tile over the reinforced areas. Planning block locations beforehand ensures support bars withstand substantial downward force without damaging finished tile surfaces.
acceptedAnswer.description: Walls are opened during demolition to install solid 2x6 or 2x8 wood blocking between studs before drywall and tile are installed, ensuring rock-solid mounting.
